The Origin
Riding the Angular Rewrite — When Everyone Else Panicked

In 2016 the entire Angular community panicked over the ground-up rewrite. I leaned in. I spent nights understanding the new compilation model, DI system, and component architecture from scratch. That crucible shaped my core belief: deep framework internals knowledge is a superpower, not a nice-to-have.

The Crucible
Inheriting a $50k Banking Platform at v6 — Zero Regression Policy

At Primus in 2021 I inherited a creaking Angular v6 codebase powering a live banking platform. Management wanted v19. Zero downtime, zero regressions. I built custom schematics, designed automated safe-migration patterns, and shipped the full migration over 18 months without a single production regression. That playbook is now used org-wide.
